definitions.explanation: For an extended or unlimited period.

examples.japanese: いつまでも{忘|わす}れません。
いつまでもお{元気|げんき}で。
いつまでも{待|ま}っていられない。

notes:
いつまでも expresses indefinite continuation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いつまでも + verb (forever ~)
- いつまでも + negative (can't ~ forever)
- いつまでもお{幸|しあわ}せに (may you be happy forever)

NUANCES:
- Positive: eternal, lasting (love, memories)
- Negative: won't end, dragging on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ずっと: all along, continuously
- いつまでも: forever (emotional emphasis)
- {永遠|えいえん}に: eternally (formal)
